lines.zh: 我不需要走路，脚离地半寸。
lines.en: I don't need to walk; my feet hover half an inch up.
The air carries me over the treetops.

lines.zh: 我飘过去，草只弯了一下。
lines.en: I drift past and the grass only bends once.

lines.zh: 这具身体完美无缺，走路都多余。
lines.en: This body is flawless; walking is beneath it.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑行，看你们跑。
lines.en: I skim the ground and watch you run.
I take measured steps, like a stroll.

lines.zh: 身后留一串浅浅的脚印。
lines.en: A faint line of prints trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，慢慢飞。
lines.en: I clasp my hands behind me and fly slowly.

lines.zh: 这对翅膀只是装饰，我靠气飞。
lines.en: These wings are ornament; I fly on ki.
I crest the ridge and pass over.
The wind splits behind me with a dull boom.
I look down at my own palm.

lines.zh: 完美的线条，我欣赏了一会儿。
lines.en: Flawless lines — I admire them a while.
I steady my breath, and my ki settles.

lines.zh: 周围的声音我都听得清。
lines.en: I hear every sound around me.
I wait for you to exhaust your tricks.
My tail is motionless as sculpture.
I extend my fingers joint by joint.

lines.zh: 气在我体表流动，几乎无声。
lines.en: Ki flows over my skin, nearly silent.
I look up; the sky is not so high.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，因为无人能及。
lines.en: I smile, because no one compares.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我壳上，泛着绿。
lines.en: Sunlight on my shell gives a green sheen.

lines.zh: 我不需要休息，只是无聊。
lines.en: I need no rest; I am merely bored.

lines.zh: 你站得太直了，像在装勇敢。
lines.en: You stand too straight, pretending courage.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，这个角度我很熟。
lines.en: I look down at you; I know this angle well.

lines.zh: 你身上没有一点像样的气。
lines.en: There is not a trace of decent ki on you.
You want to fight me? Stand properly first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能看清你的每一次呼吸。
lines.en: My eyes can count every breath you take.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，我看得一清二楚。
lines.en: Your hands tremble; I see it perfectly.

lines.zh: 你这点个头，够不到我的下巴。
lines.en: At your height you can't reach my chin.
No rush. Find your words first.

lines.zh: 我在看你的弱点，已经找到了。
lines.en: I am reading your weakness. Found it.

lines.zh: 你以为躲起来我就看不见？
lines.en: Think hiding makes you invisible to me?
I tilt my head and measure you.

lines.zh: 你这副样子，值得我动手吗。
lines.en: Is a creature like you worth my effort?

lines.zh: 我见过太多你这样的人。
lines.en: I have seen too many of your kind.
Stay there and let me look.

lines.zh: 你身后的同伴，我数过了。
lines.en: I have counted the companions behind you.
Your heartbeat skipped a beat.

lines.zh: 就是这个表情，我记住了。
lines.en: That expression — I will remember it.
I look down at the mark.
You actually touched me.
I step back half a pace, unused to this.
You surprised me somewhat.
That didn't hurt; it was embarrassing.
I frowned. You had better step back.
Even a perfect body keeps marks.

lines.zh: 这具完美的身体不该有这种感觉。
lines.en: This perfect body should not feel such things.

lines.zh: 食物？我的养分是别人的气。
lines.en: Food? My nourishment is other people's ki.

lines.zh: 你举着那个，是在羞辱我吗。
lines.en: Are you holding that up to insult me?

lines.zh: 我对那种东西没有兴趣。
lines.en: That holds no interest for me.
Take it away; don't soil my shell.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢你身上的能量。
lines.en: I prefer the energy inside you.

lines.zh: 你把那东西收起来，站直。
lines.en: Put it away and stand up straight.
I brush it aside with one hand.
That is not enough to feed me.
Don't try to please me with it. Fight.
You hit me like a stone wall.
My shell is harder than iron.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我半步没让。
lines.en: You gave two steps; I gave none.
Stand this close and my ki will burn you.
I push you back a foot.

lines.zh: 翅膀是我身上最不该碰的地方。
lines.en: The wings are the last thing you should touch.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞歪了，自己扶正。
lines.en: You knocked your own shoulder loose. Fix it.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你就在我脚边。
lines.en: I look down; you are right at my feet.

lines.zh: 我是完美的，不需要另一半。
lines.en: I am perfect; I need no other half.

lines.zh: 你连我的一根手指都配不上。
lines.en: You aren't worth one of my fingers.
I withdraw my hand, politely.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我对你没兴趣。
lines.en: Don't come closer; I have no interest.
Of my kind, there is only me.
You are amusing, but no.
I turn aside from your hand.
I never grow close to the weak.
Stand back. Don't make me repeat it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，看了看又扔了。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and drop it.

lines.zh: 这种东西也配进我的手。
lines.en: Does this deserve my hand?
This bead on the ground still glows.
I tuck it into a seam of my shell.
You dropped it? I stepped on it.
I squeeze it; too soft.
I keep only what is useful.
I don't care who dropped it.
Good. You have my attention.

lines.zh: 我把气提起来，地面开始震。
lines.en: I raise my ki and the ground shakes.
That blow of yours counts as provocation.

lines.zh: 我改变主意了，先解决你。
lines.en: I changed my mind; you go first.

lines.zh: 完美的猎场，缺一个对手。
lines.en: A perfect arena lacks one opponent.
I give your spirit three points.
I lift my palm and light gathers.

lines.zh: 我数到十，你就没机会了。
lines.en: I count to ten and your chance is gone.
You ruined my landing spot.
The lead always arrives last.
I am getting serious.
This clearing will do nicely.
I admit, you have some nerve.
Don't thank me yet.
I grant you the first three blows.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，气在脚下留痕。
lines.en: I circle you, ki leaving marks underfoot.

lines.zh: 你的招式太慢，我早看穿了。
lines.en: Your moves are slow; I saw through them.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，你打了个空。
lines.en: I step aside and you hit nothing.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，我已经到你背后。
lines.en: My afterimage stays; I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，一颗小气弹飞过去。
lines.en: I raise a hand; a small ki blast flies.
You guard left; the right is open.

lines.zh: 我不是在躲，是在挑位置。
lines.en: I am not dodging; I am choosing ground.
I level my palm at you.

lines.zh: 你每一次眨眼我都记着。
lines.en: I note every blink.
I am waiting for your strength to run out.

lines.zh: 这一招叫魔贯光杀炮，记住了。
lines.en: This is the Special Beam Cannon. Remember it.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下来，气流先到。
lines.en: I come from above; the air arrives first.

lines.zh: 我掌心的光，正对着你的背。
lines.en: The light in my palm is aimed at your back.
I laughed aloud. Apologies.
How many breaths do you have left?

lines.zh: 我抬手一记，你飞了出去。
lines.en: One backhand and you fly.

lines.zh: 我的拳峰擦过你的护肩。
lines.en: My knuckles graze your shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，往下一砸。
lines.en: I seize your wrist and slam it down.

lines.zh: 你被自己的重量压住了。
lines.en: Your own weight pins you.
I kick your knee; it cracks.
Kamehameha. Take it.
I close in, elbow first.
Good block. Useless.
That was three-tenths of my strength.
My knee drives into your chest plate.

lines.zh: 你一掌打空，我已在侧面。
lines.en: Your palm misses; I am at your flank.
My knee is harder than your skull.
Light bursts from my palm.
You back three steps and kneel.
I improved this one.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴能吸干一座城。
lines.en: My tail can drain a whole city.
I step out of the pillar of light.
So this is my stage.

lines.zh: 壳上还带着培养液的味。
lines.en: My shell still smells of culture fluid.

lines.zh: 我抬头，打量着这个世界。
lines.en: I look up and take the world's measure.

lines.zh: 一开始就该有人迎接我。
lines.en: Someone should have been here to greet me.

lines.zh: 我落地，土被压出一个圈。
lines.en: I land and the soil dents in a ring.

lines.zh: 二十一亿，这个数字够用。
lines.en: Two point one billion. That number will do.

lines.zh: 我的身体没有一处多余。
lines.en: Not one part of my body is surplus.
The air is thin, but tolerable.
I spread my wings, then fold them.
Someone nearby is shivering.
Perfect. No more evolving.
This body is ready.
The light fades and I stand tall.
First, some entertainment.
I walk slowly out of that ring of scorched earth.
Fire? My shell does not fear heat.
Landing hard, I only sway.

lines.zh: 水压着我，我不需要呼吸。
lines.en: Water presses on me; I need no air.
The blast flips my wings open.

lines.zh: 有个尖东西卡在壳缝里。
lines.en: Something sharp is lodged in a shell seam.
Spell-light coils around my wrist.
Too long without absorbing energy.
Lightning on my shell, briefly numb.
The void pulls and I still resist.
